summary: Iteration 4 (Facturas rectificativas) fully validated. Backend 10/10 pytest passing (3 new rectificativa tests + 7 regression from test_new_features). Frontend UI flow confirmed via Playwright: normal invoice creation still works (series 'FAC' preloaded, preview + total live), 'invoice-rectify-{number}' button visible only on non-rectificativa rows, clicking opens dialog 'Nueva factura rectificativa' with rectify-banner naming original invoice, series 'R' preloaded, client precargado, and line prices auto-negated (-100/-2450 -> total -2597,00 €). After save, R-2026-XXXX row appears with purple 'Rectificativa' badge and negative totals; the R row has NO 'Crear rectificativa' button rendered. Backend verified: independent R sequence (R-2026-0001..0004), invoice_type/rectifies/rectifies_number persisted, rectify_prefix from /api/company respected (custom 'ABN' also worked -> ABN-2026-0001), PDF endpoint returns %PDF for rectificativas, dashboard aggregates negatives correctly (numeric quarters).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y console warning, non-blocking, existing from prior iterations)

critical_code_review_comments: server.create_invoice: series resolution correctly branches by invoice_type; sequence uses count_documents by series+year prefix regex which is O(n) but fine for MVP volume (index on user_id exists).
server.update_invoice: preserves number/series on PUT — correct. Note it also strips series from incoming payload so a rectificativa cannot be reclassified via edit (good).

Invoices.js openRectify negates unit_price via -Math.abs — safe against already-negative inputs. However, dashboard aggregation relies on inv.base being negative; verified via backend compute_invoice.
server.py has grown ~547 lines; consider extracting invoice/expense routes into routers/ modules in a future refactor (non-blocking).

InvoiceInput.rectifies is a free-form string with no server-side validation that it references an existing invoice of the same user; a malicious/erroneous POST could store an orphan reference. Low priority for MVP but worth adding a check.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_ITER4_Cliente/TEST_ITER4_CLI2 invoices and R-/ABN- rectificativas (harmless residuals). Frontend test created TEST_ITER4_UI_Cliente FAC-2026-0007 and R-2026-0004.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4 features (rectificativa creation, independent R series, rectify_prefix in company, PDF header for rectificativas, badge in list, hiding rectify button on rectificativa rows) verified end-to-end. Selectors used: invoice-rectify-{number}, rectify-banner, invoice-series (preloaded 'R'), invoice-row-R-{...}. No open issues.
